title: Falha após candidato completo e antes da ativação governada

execution.method: Source-grounded case mining; not product execution

limits: Não é aceite global nem fechamento do AC-07.
G3-01, G3-02 e G3-03 são herdados sem novo julgamento; AC-03 não é reaberto; old-producer permanece INDETERMINATE.
Nenhum cenário permite servir bytes/sidecar untrusted. Reviews de fixture são mecânicos e explicitamente sintéticos.
minedFinding: The private-candidate and governed-publication boundaries already exist. The exact residual composes them with process interruption after a completed candidate and before atlas-emit; a success/reopen case or CAS-put refusal alone does not exercise this schedule.
preconditions: Use a private temporary git repository and createDiskStore, following ownershipFixture. Review records are explicitly synthetic structural fixtures, not semantic judge decisions.
Publish incumbent M0 through the composed atlas-emit handler with the fixture actor/policy/ratification context. Record the actual resulting manifest/result identities and projection bytes.
Bind all source, recipe and contract inputs in the baseline. Create a distinct source identity through a real edit to src/util.ts; identities are compared for equality, never ordered.

Run the existing rebuild executor against M0 using a fixed deterministic fixture recipe, host observations/captured bytes and persisted review fixtures. Require an actual candidate return M1 and actual changed recipe call evidence.

payload.operation: change file:src/util.ts from its captured bytes to 'export const changed = true\n'
payload.candidate: M1 is the actual hash returned by rebuildOwnershipUpdate; never a hand-invented digest.
payload.carrier: ownershipFixture.carrier(M1), constructed only after candidate generation, no direct projection write.

fault: In a writer subprocess, after rebuildOwnershipUpdate returned candidate and a separate disk reader can load M1 and its required CAS closure, terminate before the first handler.handle('atlas-emit') invocation. The barrier is test orchestration; it must not publish a carrier or add a product migration/resume API.
steps: Reader process records current read before candidate generation.
Writer generates M1; observer verifies CAS objects and obtains a barrier event before activation.
Terminate writer at that barrier; start a fresh composed runtime against the same repository and current source bytes.
Read via runtime.ownership.read and record manifest/result, kind, reason, historical flag and returned body bytes.
oracle: After source drift, the default current read is HOLD; it must never return stale M0 as ready/current or expose unpublished M1.
If the separate no-drift control keeps M0 valid, the only ready result before activation is exact M0 with its complete accepted structural closure.
Projection bytes/current carrier remain unchanged by generation and by the pre-activation interruption.
The trust guard remains active. Any untrusted classification yields HOLD/no served projection, irrespective of CAS objects preserved on disk.
An uninterrupted authorized control activates M1 through atlas-emit and then returns exact M1. All refs are those observed at runtime.

negativeControls.control: Attempt to observe M1 as current after raw CAS puts but before atlas-emit: it must remain unreachable through the current reader.
After drift, serving preserved incumbent bytes as ready/current must fail the oracle; persistence alone does not grant current validity.
Interrupt before candidate completion: never treat a partialManifest CAS ref as a complete candidate or activation authority.

evidence.finding: Obrigação AC-07 congelada; a mineração limita-se ao resíduo nomeado neste caso.
Executor writes immutable result/receipt/artifact/manifest objects; final candidate is separate from activation and never mutates projection.
Reader selects only a governed carrier from the provenance-filtered projection, then validates via readOwnership; raw CAS writes cannot select a current manifest.
Real emit performs ownershipAttachmentRefusal inside commitProjection.
Existing controls cover private CAS, authorization/reopen and drift HOLD separately, without interruption at the generation/activation gap.
Existing disk-full put test aborts before a generation, but directly calls commitSidecar with a throwing put and has no incumbent/current ownership reader; it is supporting primitive evidence only.
Accepted RP-3 names token refusal and successful publication/reopen; it does not name this injected interruption.

executionGap: No read accepted verdict names this residual schedule, and no such schedule was executed in this mining subtask. A new CI control must exercise the two real entry points and separate reader; repeating existing G3-01/02 does not supply that evidence.
framingError: Treating a complete CAS candidate, a no-token refusal or successful publication/reopen as an observed failure between generation and activation skips the actual interruption and reader observation.
scopeQualification: Interrupção de processo pós-candidato/pré-atlas-emit. Não é prova de perda de energia nem de todos os pontos físicos de falha dentro da publicação.
